requirements.requirement: The system must map provider scoring responses from EVAL-SCORE-PROV into the frontend explainability schema defined in EVAL-EXPLAIN-UX-S1.
The system must map clinical trial scoring responses from EVAL-SCORE-CT into the frontend explainability schema defined in EVAL-EXPLAIN-UX-S1.
The system must merge EVAL-EXPLAIN response data with score responses to produce a unified explainability payload.
The system must correctly map overall score values into the explainability schema numeric score field.
The system must transform backend measure-level data into a normalized list of measures including name, value, weight, and contribution.
The system must preserve numeric precision for weights and contribution percentages during mapping without unintended rounding errors.
The system must handle missing measure fields by substituting null or default values without causing rendering failures.
The system must return a valid explainability payload structure even when the backend response is partially populated.
The system must omit or flag malformed measures that cannot be safely mapped into the schema.
The system must support both provider and clinical trial payload shapes without requiring separate frontend schema definitions.
The system must ensure the mapped payload conforms to the TypeScript interface defined in EVAL-EXPLAIN-UX-S1.
The system must handle completely missing backend responses by returning an empty explainability payload with no measures and no score.
The system must log mapping errors or schema mismatches for debugging without interrupting the user experience.
The system must maintain consistent field naming and casing conventions between backend data and frontend schema.
